relations.subject: Philippe Édouard Foucaux
relations.evidence: At the age of 27, he left for Paris to study Indology with Eugène Burnouf.

relations.subject: Philippe Édouard Foucaux
relations.evidence: After becoming aware of the work of Sándor Kőrösi Csoma, he studied Tibetan by himself for two years.

relations.subject: Philippe Édouard Foucaux
relations.evidence: After this he was appointed as a Tibetan teacher at the École des langues orientales where he gave his inaugural lecture on 31 January 1842.
